drafted_from: tool row in tools/compare-voice-and-music-models/tool-rows.json, do-work/render_takes.sh, say_a_line_in_kokoro.py (--take-rows run for real) and tools/compare-voice-and-music-models/test/test_voice_ab.py
start_here: Say to your AI: "Make my narration line in line.json in every voice take my made-up-film settings row lists, master them all the same way, and measure them into ./ab."

lists.label: Settings
lists.holds: One row per tool and scope (a person, a film, a piece or the whole account): the settings that tool reads when it runs, as JSON.

instructions: 1. Pour the example settings rows into your list:settings (see pour), then set takes, clean_command, master_command, ticks_command and measure_glob in your row; with no row the six default takes and master_command "showtime voice master" are used.

2. Say the line in start_here. Your AI reads the row with tools:list {tool: "tool:make-and-measure-every-voice-take-of-a-line"}, saves your settings row to a file and runs the command in given (minutes per take, one heavy job at a time).
3. Read the last line: {"result": {"takes": <how many>, "measures": "<out dir>/work/measure-final.jsonl"}}; a take already in the folder is moved to work/replaced/ before it is made again.
4. Show the measures beside each take for the person to listen to.

worked_examples.title: The made-up film row lists two takes, a clone and a Kokoro voice
worked_examples.ask: Make and measure every voice take of my line for made-up-film.
worked_examples.given: From tools/compare-voice-and-music-models/test/test_voice_ab.py (Settings.test_the_film_row_is_read_by_the_settings_reader_over_the_defaults; Render). settings-rows.json holds the row from tools/compare-voice-and-music-models/test/fixtures/settings-row.json (clone_takes 5, master_command "", takes pocket then af_heart). The script first reads the takes: it makes pocket|B pocket|say_a_line_in_a_cloned_voice.py pocket and synthetic-601f4f805f94|A kokoro|say_a_line_in_kokoro.py af_heart. line.json = {"script":"Close. The kettle is on... and the toast is burning. Aren't you, Morwenna?","units":["Close.","The kettle is on... and the toast is burning.","Aren't you, [Morwenna](/mɔːwˈɛnə/)?"],"pause_after":[0.65,0.4,0.0],"inner_most":0.45,"hear_prompt":"Morwenna.","voice_reference":"reference-take.wav","vowel_check":{"word":"close"}}. Run: bash tools/compare-voice-and-music-models/do-work/render_takes.sh line.json ./ab settings-rows.json made-up-film
worked_examples.hands_back: {"result":{"takes":2,"measures":"/<absolute path of ./ab>/work/measure-final.jsonl"}}: ./ab/B pocket.wav and ./ab/A kokoro.wav are made (no master step because master_command is empty), then measured, one JSON row per take in work/measure-final.jsonl. If a take cannot be made it stops: {"error":"take pocket was not made: ..."} (exit 2); for the wrong film {"error":"... pass --film ..."}.

pour.how: Name the list you already keep for the same job and read it with records:read (its fields and row type). Run tool:pour-example-rows-into-my-list with that list as into and this kit list as kit_list: it matches each kit field to one of yours (your map, the same id, the same label, or a name in alike), pours nothing under 80% and names the fields with no home, and otherwise answers the one records:write that adds the example rows beside your own.
